description: Letter of recommendation, or maybe conveying the arrival of a certain Najīb al-Dawla. The writer introduces Najīb al-Dawla to the addressee and conveys his desire to meet with him so that he may seek his counsel, benefit from his generosity, and deliver his zakāt. There is a mention of 700, but not sure if that refers to the year or a sum. Reused for Hebrew piyyuṭ.
description_he: מכתב קצר בכתב ערבי. 7 שורות; נראה שלם. בקשה להיפגש עם הנמען לקבלת עצה. דרוש בדיקה נוספת. נוצל מחדש לפיוט עברי.
